exposure: Risk factors for severe perioperative surgical morbidity
outcome: Severe perioperative surgical morbidity (composite index including intra-abdominal or pelvic visceral and vascular injuries, hysterectomy, pelvic or retroperitoneal hematoma, wound complications, ileus or bowel obstruction, acute peritonitis, and shock)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 594,655 patients who underwent cesarean delivery in any California hospital between 2016 and 2021.
finding: Nearly 1 in 60 patients undergoing cesarean delivery in California experienced severe perioperative surgical morbidity, with placenta accreta spectrum disorder identified as the highest risk factor.
mod_finding: Severe perioperative surgical morbidity prevalence was higher among patients undergoing intrapartum compared with prelabor cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for cesarean deliveries performed between 2016 and 2021.
